S2.decision_DMC: The DMC shape correction is KEPT in transported form: the zero-mode Hamiltonian (gauge kinetic + magnetic + mass terms + body-frame angular term + hypercharge oscillator) with couplings kappa*(g2, gY) is unitarily equivalent to kappa^(2/3) times the kappa = 1 Hamiltonian at r' = kappa^(1/3) r (x -> kappa^(-1/3) x), so the exact-minus-Gaussian energy obeys dE_DMC(kappa; r) = kappa^(2/3) dE_DMC(1; kappa^(1/3) r) exactly; no new DMC run is needed and the model reduces to the production 2D_ex at kappa = 1 ('2D_Gdmcs', main). Keeping dE_DMC unscaled would attach the kappa = 1 correction to a different Hamiltonian (it would even survive at kappa = 0). Dropping it ('2D_G') gives the strict variational bracket. The exact scaling was verified numerically without the matching (scalecheck).
